# HireQuotient

HireQuotient is an AI-native applicant tracking system purpose-built for high-volume, frontline hiring. It combines autonomous outbound candidate discovery, pre-verified contact enrichment, and personalized AI outreach with a consolidated system of record that replaces fragmented stacks of spreadsheets, legacy databases, and point solutions. The platform integrates directly into Paylocity, expanding access to manufacturing, building services, construction, healthcare, and insurance sectors historically underserved by AI recruiting tools. Early customers report 70–80% reductions in manual sourcing and screening effort, with time-to-hire cuts of 50% or more.

## Timeline

- **20 Jul 2026** — HireQuotient integrated its AI recruiter into Paylocity, pushing AI candidate sourcing and screening to Paylocity customers in manufacturing, building services, construction, healthcare and insurance — frontline sectors historically underserved by AI hiring tools. If you run high-volume deskless hiring on Paylocity, the sourcing/screening layer now arrives as a native integration rather than a separate buy; scope where it touches candidate decisions before switching it on. — [TechStartups](https://techstartups.com/2026/07/20/hirequotient-extends-ai-recruiting-capabilities-to-paylocity-customers-in-frontline-industries/)

- **12 Aug 2026** — HireQuotient joined Paylocity's partner network, reporting an early customer (W3 Insurance) cut manual recruiting effort 80% and time-to-hire 50%. The story to track isn't the testimonial but the pattern: AI sourcing/screening embedding directly into payroll-HCM ecosystems, which changes how mid-market teams buy recruiting tech. — [GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/12/3343796/0/en/hirequotient-announces-w3-insurance-achieves-80-reduction-in-manual-recruiting-effort-using-easysource.html)

- **25 Aug 2026** — Alliance Building Services reported closing 35+ specialized, heavily regulated roles while reclaiming 70% of the manual effort previously consumed by sourcing and accelerating time-to-close by more than half, consolidating a fragmented software stack onto a single AI-native applicant tracking system. The vendor's framing is worth pressure-testing: conventional ATS platforms lack autonomous outbound candidate discovery, pre-verified contact enrichment, and personalized AI outreach — an ATS is a system of record and a spreadsheet is a system of memory; neither is a system of action. — [GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/25/3350330/0/en/hirequotient-delivers-70-reduction-in-manual-recruiting-effort-for-nyc-s-alliance-building-services.html)
